preToolUse.command: specforge hook gsd.read_guard --host cursor --event pre_tool --tools write,edit # specforge-install
specforge hook gsd.write_guard --host cursor --event pre_tool --tools write --paths 'spec/**/*.spec' # specforge-install
specforge hook gsd.secret_read_guard --host cursor --event pre_tool --tools read,search,shell # specforge-install
specforge hook gsd.prompt_guard --host cursor --event pre_tool --tools write,edit --paths 'spec/**' # specforge-install
specforge hook gsd.worktree_path_guard --host cursor --event pre_tool --tools write,edit # specforge-install

command -v specforge >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'specforge is not on PATH: the hook core.spec_guard cannot run, so it denies' >&2; exit 2; }; specforge hook core.spec_guard --host cursor --event pre_tool --tools write,edit --paths 'spec/**/*.spec' # specforge-install

postToolUse.command: specforge hook gsd.injection_scanner --host cursor --event post_tool --tools read,web_fetch,web_search # specforge-install
specforge hook gsd.context_monitor --host cursor --event post_tool --tools shell,write,edit,agent # specforge-install

beforeSubmitPrompt.command: specforge hook gsd.workflow_marker --host cursor --event user_prompt # specforge-install
